analysis_name: Milky Way Stage 4E independent young-tracer response to source-history map

coordinate_model.note: Vphi sign standardized so median prograde disk rotation is positive; inference uses within-cell anomalies.

primary_interpretation_rule: The strongest persistence-compatible precursor would be a source-history predictor that survives within-R-|z| permutation, source age/FeH/aFe adjustment, family-wise maxT correction, and appears with a consistent sign in both the general and cold young-tracer samples. Young-star Vphi^2/R is only a circular-acceleration proxy, not a full local force measurement; Vr/Vz streaming and standard bar/spiral dynamics remain required controls.
